Queen's Recruit#000.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E{~}.

Queen's Recruit#001.src: Room W{~}... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#001.dst: W{~}호실... 이제 가 봐. 배정할 방이 아직 많아...

Queen's Recruit#003.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#004.src: {u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
Queen's Recruit#004.dst: {u}! 어이! 여기서 널 만나다니 운이 좋네.
Queen's Recruit#004.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#005.src: It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
Queen's Recruit#005.dst: 오랜만이지? 밀린 얘기 좀 하자! 그동안 모험 많이 했겠지?
Queen's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#006.src: But before that... I've just got to find...
Queen's Recruit#006.dst: 근데 그 전에... 찾아야 할 게...
Queen's Recruit#006.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#007.src: Huh? What am I oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#007.dst: 응? 내가 뭘... 아, 맞다. Aledar를 찾고 있었어.
Queen's Recruit#007.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#008.src: He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
Queen's Recruit#008.dst: 무슨... 정찰 임무에 같이 가자고 편지를 보냈더라고. 근데 도통 못 찾겠어.
Queen's Recruit#008.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#009.src: It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
Queen's Recruit#009.dst: 여기 오는 데 좀 오래 걸렸으니까... 벌써 딴 데로 갔을지도. Aegis 말로는 그 임무도 결국 취소됐다던데...
Queen's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#010.src: But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
Queen's Recruit#010.dst: 여기 없으면 길에서 찾아 헤맬 필요는 없겠지? 병영에 메시지나 남겨 둘게.
Queen's Recruit#010.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#011.src: We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
Queen's Recruit#011.dst: 우리는 술집에 가서 회포나 풀자! 아, Rusty Recruit 술이 그리웠어... 거기 주인은 딴 데랑 똑같다지만, 절대 아니야! 그렇게 따르는 데는 없어.
Queen's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#012.src: Pardon me, excuse me- coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#012.dst: 실례합니다, 잠시만요- 지나갈게요! 지나갑니다! 아, 두 분! 딱 찾던 분들이네요.
Queen's Recruit#012.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#013.src: Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#013.dst: 실례합니다, 잠시만요- 지나갈게요! 지나갑니다! 아, 두 분! 딱 찾던 분들이네요.
Queen's Recruit#013.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#015.src: Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
Queen's Recruit#015.dst: 뭐, 콕 집은 건 아니고요. 찾아야 할 사람 명단이 있는데, 두 분도 거기 있거든요! Tasim이랑 {u}, 맞죠?
Queen's Recruit#015.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#016.src: I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
Queen's Recruit#016.dst: {p}에서 온 중요한 서신이 있어요. 국왕 폐하께서 직접 보내신 거예요, 네네!
Queen's Recruit#016.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#017.src: Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
Queen's Recruit#017.dst: 정말? 그분 뵌 지가 언제더라... 대체 우리한테 무슨 볼일이지?
Queen's Recruit#017.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#018.src: I'm not privy to the details I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned visitors to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
Queen's Recruit#018.dst: 자세한 건 저도 몰라요! 두 분 같은 노련한 방문자 여럿을 회의 같은 걸로 성으로 부르고 계세요.
Queen's Recruit#018.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#019.src: Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
Queen's Recruit#019.dst: 아무튼 전 찾을 사람이 더 있어서, 편지만 드리고 가 볼게요! 무슨 일이든 행운을 빌어요!
Queen's Recruit#019.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#021.src: Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks for later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
Queen's Recruit#021.dst: 흠. 이상하지 않아? 술은 나중으로 미뤄야겠네... 차라리 잘됐지. 어쩌면 그 전에 그를 만날 수도...
Queen's Recruit#021.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#022.src: Oh, uh- you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
Queen's Recruit#022.dst: 아, 어- 먼저 가. 난 병영에 먼저 들러야 해. {p}에서 만나자, 응?
Queen's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#023.src: I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
Queen's Recruit#023.dst: {p}에서 만나자. 병영에서 처리할 일이 좀 있어.
Queen's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#024.src: Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#025.src: ...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
Queen's Recruit#025.dst: ...아, 여기 있었네. 나보다 먼저 출발하지 않았어?
Queen's Recruit#025.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#026.src: I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
Queen's Recruit#026.dst: 여기 아는 사람이 거의 없으니까, 일단 너랑 붙어 있을게.
Queen's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#027.src: ...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for
Queen's Recruit#027.dst: ...그러고 다 무너지는 거야, 알지? 그래서 좀비를 쳐내고, 애를 붙잡고, 뛰어서-
Queen's Recruit#027.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#028.src: Wait, wait wait wait you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
Queen's Recruit#028.dst: 잠깐, 잠깐잠깐잠깐, 애가 있었다고? 그런데도 폭탄을 터뜨렸어?!
Queen's Recruit#028.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#029.src: Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I
Queen's Recruit#029.dst: 응! 아까 말했잖아? 그게 바로 내가-
Queen's Recruit#029.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#030.src: Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
Queen's Recruit#030.dst: 에헴. 이야기는 잠깐 멈춰요, Linton. 손님이 왔어요.
Queen's Recruit#030.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#031.src: Well if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
Queen's Recruit#031.dst: 아이고, {u} 아니야! 이런 데서 아는 얼굴 보니 좋네.
Queen's Recruit#031.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#033.src: I do try to keep my distance.
Queen's Recruit#033.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#034.src: So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
Queen's Recruit#034.dst: 당신도 소집장을 받았군요? 국왕께서 많이도 부르셨네요. 흥미로워요.
Queen's Recruit#034.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#035.src: We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
Queen's Recruit#035.dst: 네, 받았어요. 게다가 명단에 찾는 사람이 더 있는 것 같더라고요.
Queen's Recruit#035.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#036.src: Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
Queen's Recruit#036.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#037.src: I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#037.dst: 네! 같은 마차를 타고 Wynn에 왔어요. 전 Tasim이에요.
Queen's Recruit#037.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#039.src: So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#039.dst: Aledar가 맨날 말하던 게 너구나! Gavel에 간 줄 알았는데?
Queen's Recruit#039.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#040.src: I... was. How do you all know him?
Queen's Recruit#040.dst: 가... 있었죠. 다들 그를 어떻게 알아요?
Queen's Recruit#040.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#041.src: I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
Queen's Recruit#041.dst: 처음 만난 건 반역한 지휘관에게서 {p}의 병영을 되찾는 임무였을 거예요. 그 뒤로 몇 번 마주쳤죠.
Queen's Recruit#041.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#042.src: Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
Queen's Recruit#042.dst: 그래도, 드디어 만나서 반갑다! 얘기 많이 들었어! 편지에 답장 안 했다는 얘기도 있던데...?
Queen's Recruit#042.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#043.src: Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
Queen's Recruit#043.dst: 아... 네. 그건, 어... 잘 풀었어요.
Queen's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#044.src: But speaking of have any of you seen him recently?
Queen's Recruit#044.dst: 그런데 말 나온 김에... 최근에 그를 본 사람 있어요?
Queen's Recruit#044.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#045.src: 'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
Queen's Recruit#045.dst: 아쉽지만 없어. 마지막으로 마주친 게... {p} 공성전이었나? 그랬을 거야.
Queen's Recruit#045.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#046.src: I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
Queen's Recruit#046.dst: 한 달 전에 {p}에서 봤어! 뭐 하냐고, 도와줄까 물었더니 그냥 날 떼어 내더라. 이상하지?
Queen's Recruit#046.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#047.src: Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
Queen's Recruit#047.dst: 음. 아뇨, 그 사람답네요. 지난번 당신 장난질에 질렸나 보죠.
Queen's Recruit#047.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#048.src: What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
Queen's Recruit#048.dst: 뭐?! 나 유능하거든. 아 좀, Mel, 나 유능하다고 말해 줘.
Queen's Recruit#048.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#049.src: Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by
Queen's Recruit#049.dst: Linton, 방금 네가 신전 하나를 통째로 무너뜨린 얘기를 했잖아-
Queen's Recruit#049.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#050.src: Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
Queen's Recruit#050.dst: 알았어! 알았어, 알았다고, 딴 얘기 하자, 아무거나! Tasim이랬지? 너... 어...
Queen's Recruit#050.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#051.src: ...so, your... no, no, give me a moment you were... and... um... oh, right...
Queen's Recruit#051.dst: ...그러니까, 네... 아니, 아니, 잠깐만- 너는... 그리고... 음... 아, 맞다...
Queen's Recruit#051.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#054.src: Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Queen's Recruit#054.dst: Linton!! 그런 걸 막 물어보면 어떡해!!
Queen's Recruit#054.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#056.src: It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
Queen's Recruit#056.dst: 만나서 반가웠어요, Tasim. 이번 임무 함께하길 기대할게요.
Queen's Recruit#056.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#057.src: ...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#057.dst: ...저도요. Aledar의 친구들을 만나는 건 늘 좋네요.
Queen's Recruit#057.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#058.src: Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
Queen's Recruit#058.dst: 이야, 이게 누구야! 마지막으로 얘기한 게 한참 전이구먼. 이제 하수도 청소할 급은 아니겠지, 응?
Queen's Recruit#058.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#059.src: I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
Queen's Recruit#059.dst: 네 활약 얘기 좀 들었다. 잘했어, 잘했어.
Queen's Recruit#059.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#060.src: And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
Queen's Recruit#060.dst: 그리고... 흠. 너 한마디 없이 Gavel로 떠난 녀석 아니냐? 이번에 뽑힐 줄은 몰랐구먼.
Queen's Recruit#060.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#061.src: I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
Queen's Recruit#061.dst: 저도... 몰랐어요. 솔직히 국왕께서 절 기억하시는 줄도 몰랐고요.
Queen's Recruit#061.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#062.src: Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get or so Kymer's been sayin'.
Queen's Recruit#062.dst: 음. 뭐, 이유가 뭐든 지금 여기 있잖냐. 어떤 길로 왔는지는 별로 중요하지 않겠지. 사람은 있는 대로 다 필요하니까... Kymer 말로는 그렇다더군.
Queen's Recruit#062.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#063.src: Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#063.dst: 이런, 이런! 내 눈이 틀리지 않았다면! {u}와 Tasim 아닌가!
Queen's Recruit#063.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#064.src: I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#064.dst: 솔직히 자네들을 찾아낼 줄은 몰랐네! Gavel에서... 꽤 오래 있었으니 말이야.
Queen's Recruit#064.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#065.src: I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
Queen's Recruit#065.dst: 저도 같은 말씀 드리고 싶네요, 대장님. 전쟁이 끝나니 {p}에서 쓸모가 없어졌나요?
Queen's Recruit#065.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#066.src: Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
Queen's Recruit#066.dst: 아... 그런 게 아닐세. 난 원래 {p}의 사절에 가까운 역할로 거기 파견됐다네! 폐하께서 외교 문제를 해결하실 때 가장 먼저 찾는 게 나지.
Queen's Recruit#066.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#067.src: Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've entered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
Queen's Recruit#067.dst: 그래서... 지금 여기 온 거고. 몇 주 전에 꽤 급하게 소환됐지. 우리가 그... 이웃 지방과 곤란한 상황에 놓인 모양이야.
Queen's Recruit#067.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#068.src: But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
Queen's Recruit#068.dst: 하지만! 폐하께서 오시기 전엔 더 말하지 않겠네. 문제는 폐하께서 직접 말씀하실 걸세. 해결할 수 있으면 좋겠군.
Queen's Recruit#068.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#069.src: ...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
Queen's Recruit#069.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#070.src: If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
Queen's Recruit#070.dst: 마나 흐름을 물에 맞추고, 옆으로 살짝 밀면, 아마... 아 Reynauld, 내 노트 좀... 젠장, 뭐였더라- 아 맞다, 회복 기간! 그거 줘요.
Queen's Recruit#070.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#071.src: ...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#071.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#072.src: Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half where did I leave the rest...
Queen's Recruit#072.dst: 그래요?! 그렇군요... 아, 근데 이건 앞부분뿐인데- 나머진 어디 뒀더라...
Queen's Recruit#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#073.src: Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't
Queen's Recruit#073.dst: 휴... 제가 정리하게만 해 주시면, 아마-
Queen's Recruit#073.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#074.src: And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have
Queen's Recruit#074.dst: 그래서 내 분류 체계를 망치자고요?! 아뇨, Reynauld, 지금 이대로 완벽하게 돌아가요, 고마워요! 자, 그게 어디-
Queen's Recruit#074.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#075.src: Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
Queen's Recruit#075.dst: 아! 두 사람! 좋아요, 좋아, 왔군요- 기억을 되찾은 사람이 Reynauld뿐일까 봐 걱정했어요!
Queen's Recruit#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#076.src: What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
Queen's Recruit#076.dst: 뭐예요, 우리가 떠난 뒤로 딴 사람한테 안 써 봤어요?
Queen's Recruit#076.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#077.src: Test it on no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
Queen's Recruit#077.dst: 딴 사람한테- 당연히 안 했죠! 그걸 보고 나서요? 아뇨, 그런 위험은 감수할 가치가 없어요. 완벽해질 때까진 새 실험 대상은 없어요!
Queen's Recruit#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#078.src: I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
Queen's Recruit#078.dst: 대신 제 자신한테 쓰고 있어요! 그리고 말이죠- 제가 이룬 돌파구란... 배울 게 너무 많아요.
Queen's Recruit#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#080.src: Pah! "Safety" a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects certainly! But it has all been worth it.
Queen's Recruit#080.dst: 흥! '안전'- 진보를 막으려고 만든 무의미한 말이죠. 부작용이 있었냐고요- 물론이죠! 하지만 다 그럴 가치가 있었어요.
Queen's Recruit#080.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#081.src: Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
Queen's Recruit#081.dst: 자, 원고로 돌아가야겠어요... 국왕께서 오시기 전에 다듬을 방정식이 있거든요...
Queen's Recruit#081.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#082.src: Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#082.dst: 흠. 여기서 널 볼 줄은 몰랐어, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#082.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#083.src: Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#083.dst: 글쎄... 운명이 딴 계획이 있었나 봐. 너는? {p}에 계속 있었어?
Queen's Recruit#083.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#084.src: Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
Queen's Recruit#084.dst: 대체로. 임무 몇 개로 여기저기 옮겼지만, 결국 계속 돌아갔어.
Queen's Recruit#084.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#085.src: ...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
Queen's Recruit#085.dst: ...오랫동안 얘기 못 했네. 넌... 잘 지내? 그 기억들은 어떻게 감당하고 있어?
Queen's Recruit#085.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#087.src: As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
Queen's Recruit#087.dst: 그럭저럭. 처음 몇 달은 힘들었어. 결국 익숙해지더라.
Queen's Recruit#087.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#088.src: How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
Queen's Recruit#088.dst: 너는? 네가 이런 임무에 나타날 줄은 몰랐어.
Queen's Recruit#088.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#089.src: Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
Queen's Recruit#089.dst: 너랑 같지. Caid랑 터놓고 얘기한 게 도움이 됐어. 가끔 만나서 그 얘길 해. 걔는 여동생 얘기를 해. 언젠가 꼭 찾겠대.
Queen's Recruit#089.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#091.src: Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
Queen's Recruit#091.dst: 흠. 너도 들르면 되잖아. 너한테도 도움이 될지 몰라.
Queen's Recruit#091.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#092.src: I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#092.dst: 생각... 해 볼게. 다시 봐서 반가웠어, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#092.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#093.src: Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
Queen's Recruit#093.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#094.src: ...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
Queen's Recruit#094.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#096.src: If you insist. Don't take too long.
Queen's Recruit#096.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#097.src: Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
Queen's Recruit#097.dst: 아... 모두 모였군요. 급한 부름에 와 주셔서 감사합니다. 여러분 중 많은 분을 뵌 지 오래되었군요.
Queen's Recruit#097.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#098.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to our relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#098.dst: ...바로 본론으로 들어가죠. 이웃 지방인 Fruma와의 관계에 있어서 우리는 매우 미묘한 처지에 놓여 있습니다.
Queen's Recruit#098.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#101.src: Good. I guess that makes two of us.
Queen's Recruit#101.dst: 좋아. 그럼 우리 둘 다 같은 생각이네.

Queen's Recruit#102.src: It sounds very suspicious. Why the sudden interest? Why now?
Queen's Recruit#102.dst: 아주 수상하게 들려. 왜 갑자기 관심을 보이지? 왜 하필 지금?

Queen's Recruit#103.src: We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once they have chosen to do so.
Queen's Recruit#103.dst: 우리는 그들이 보내 주는 신병에 크게 의존하지만, 그 지방에 연락할 방법이 없습니다. 연락은 오직 그들만이, 그들이 원할 때만 할 수 있죠.
Queen's Recruit#103.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#104.src: ...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#104.dst: ...몇 주 전, 외곽으로 망토를 쓴 방문객이 왔습니다. 자신이 Fruma의 군주 중 하나라고 하더군요.
Queen's Recruit#104.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#105.src: We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
Queen's Recruit#105.dst: 일종의 초대를 받았습니다. 지금껏 받은 모든 신병 중 가장 뛰어난 이들을 골라, 어떤 축제를 위해 Fruma로 보내라는 겁니다.
Queen's Recruit#105.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#106.src: Is that who we are? The greatest?
Queen's Recruit#106.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#107.src: The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove
Queen's Recruit#107.dst: 최소한 연락이 닿은 이들 중에선 말일세! 더 뛰어난 자도 있었겠지만, 자네들 같은 이들의 떠돌이 습성은 다들 알잖나. 찾아내기가 정말-
Queen's Recruit#107.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#108.src: Ugh, we're not just going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#108.dst: 으, 설마 그냥 이걸 따르려는 건 아니지?
Queen's Recruit#108.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#110.src: What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
Queen's Recruit#110.dst: 뭐? 이상하고 딱 봐도 수상한 걸 요구하는데, 왜 그냥 받아들여야 해?
Queen's Recruit#110.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#111.src: I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
Queen's Recruit#111.dst: 유감이지만 우리에겐 선택권이 없습니다. 말했듯이, 받는 신병들이 우리 지방의 존속을 좌우합니다. 만약 이 초대를 거절한다면...
Queen's Recruit#111.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#112.src: ...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
Queen's Recruit#112.dst: ...신병을 아예 안 보낼지 누가 알겠냐, 응? 골치 아프구먼.
Queen's Recruit#112.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#113.src: Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
Queen's Recruit#113.dst: 게다가, 이게 얼마나 좋은 기회인지 생각해 봐요! 저 벽 너머를 제대로, 그쪽이 먼저 보여 준다고요! 위협이 숨어 있든 말든 거절하면 바보죠!
Queen's Recruit#113.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#114.src: Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
Queen's Recruit#114.dst: 그렇습니다. 이런 부탁을 드려 유감이지만... 다른 방법이 없습니다. 이 초대를 받아들여야 합니다.
Queen's Recruit#114.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#115.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences with the province?
Queen's Recruit#115.dst: ...그 지방에 안 좋은 기억이 있는 우리까지도?
Queen's Recruit#115.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#116.src: I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
Queen's Recruit#116.dst: 미안합니다... 하지만 가야 합니다. 저도 어쩔 수 없습니다.
Queen's Recruit#116.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#117.src: I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
Queen's Recruit#117.dst: 그렇다면 그곳에 있는 동안 Fruma에 대한 정보를 최대한 모아 오라는 거겠죠?
Queen's Recruit#117.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#118.src: That is the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#118.dst: 바로 그게 계획입니다! 도착하면 더 설명드리겠지만, 시간 제한이 있는 걸로 아는데, 맞죠?
Queen's Recruit#118.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#119.src: That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#119.dst: 바로 그게 계획입니다! 도착하면 더 설명드릴게요. 근데 시간 제한이 있죠, 맞죠?
Queen's Recruit#119.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#120.src: You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
Queen's Recruit#120.dst: 맞습니다, 박사. 서쪽 해안에 있는 Fruma의 왕실 관문에서 대표가 여러분을 맞이할 거라고 들었습니다.
Queen's Recruit#120.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#121.src: I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
Queen's Recruit#121.dst: {p}에 먼저 전령을 보내, 그곳 선장들에게 여러분을 데려갈 목적지를 알려 두었습니다.
Queen's Recruit#121.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#122.src: {p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
Queen's Recruit#122.dst: {p}... 거기 아는 선장이 있어. {u}, 같이 갈래?
Queen's Recruit#122.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#123.src: Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
Queen's Recruit#123.dst: 드디어... 그 지방의 속사정을 엿볼 수 있다니... 이 답을 얼마나 오래 찾아 헤맸던가?
Queen's Recruit#123.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#124.src: So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
Queen's Recruit#124.dst: 가설이 이렇게나 많은데... 몇 개나 맞을까? 몇 개나 틀릴까? 빨리 알고 싶네요!
Queen's Recruit#124.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#125.src: Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
Queen's Recruit#125.dst: 휴... 이렇게 될 줄 알았어. 아니면 박사님을 왜 불렀겠어? 틀리길 바랐는데.
Queen's Recruit#125.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#126.src: Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
Queen's Recruit#126.dst: 골치 아픈 상황이지? Fruma 사람들은 숨기는 게 참 많아...
Queen's Recruit#126.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#127.src: But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
Queen's Recruit#127.dst: 그래도 해낼 거다. 여기 있는 녀석들은 다 실력이 좋으니까.
Queen's Recruit#127.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#128.src: Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
Queen's Recruit#128.dst: 흠... 참 묘한 상황에 처했군! 외교야 물론 내 특기지만, 내 경험으로도 이런 건... 대비가 안 돼.
Queen's Recruit#128.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#129.src: Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford to let up their position.
Queen's Recruit#129.dst: Fruma는 뭘 원하는지 알고, 한발 물러서도 될 만큼 강하다는 것도 알지.
Queen's Recruit#129.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#130.src: Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
Queen's Recruit#130.dst: 벌써 또 극비 임무야? 게다가 폭탄도 못 가져가고?
Queen's Recruit#130.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#131.src: It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
Queen's Recruit#131.dst: 그래도 재밌잖아! 지난번 임무보단 훨씬 낫네...
Queen's Recruit#131.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#132.src: This mission's a big deal, huh? Lot's o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
Queen's Recruit#132.dst: 이번 임무 큰일이지? 불러들인 강자만 해도 한가득이잖아.
Queen's Recruit#132.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#133.src: Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
Queen's Recruit#133.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#134.src: Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Queen's Recruit#134.dst: Fruma라... 크게 생각해 본 적은 없어요. 수수께끼긴 하지만, 답을 구할 수 없는 쪽이었죠.
Queen's Recruit#134.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#135.src: Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
Queen's Recruit#135.dst: 뭐, 지금까지는요. 살펴볼 세부 사항 목록부터 준비해야겠네요...
Queen's Recruit#135.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#136.src: And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
Queen's Recruit#136.dst: 또다시 여러분을 위험 속으로 보내야 하는군요... 이번엔 종류가 다르지만, 위험은 위험입니다.
Queen's Recruit#136.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#137.src: I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
Queen's Recruit#137.dst: 이 성을 거쳐 간 얼굴은 모두 기억합니다. 그중 다시 보는 이는 드물지요.
Queen's Recruit#137.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#138.src: But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. Your mission lies ahead of you.
Queen's Recruit#138.dst: 하지만 이번엔... 다시 만나리라 믿습니다. 가십시오, 젊은 영웅이여. 임무가 기다립니다.
Queen's Recruit#138.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#139.src: ...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
Queen's Recruit#139.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#140.src: But it had to happen eventually. And I do want answers. So... in we go.
Queen's Recruit#140.dst: 그래도 언젠간 일어날 일이었어. 답도 알고 싶고. 그러니... 가 보자.
Queen's Recruit#140.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#141.src: I'll be heading to the {p} Seaskipper, if you want to tag along.
Queen's Recruit#141.dst: 난 {p} 연락선으로 갈 거야. 같이 갈 거면 따라와.
Queen's Recruit#141.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#142.src: Travel to the Gate of Fruma at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or meet up with Tasim in {p}.

Queen's Recruit#143.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#143.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#144.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#144.dst: 좀 비현실적이지 않아? Wynn에 막 돌아왔는데, 이젠... Fruma라니!
Queen's Recruit#144.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#145.src: Kind of make me wish we had Aledar here too. The three of us on an adventure again! Going back... home...
Queen's Recruit#145.dst: Aledar도 여기 있으면 좋겠다. 셋이 또 모험하는 거잖아! 돌아가는 거야... 고향으로...
Queen's Recruit#145.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#146.src: I guess we'll just have to tell him all about it when we get back. He'll be sad he missed it, I bet.
Queen's Recruit#146.dst: 돌아가면 전부 얘기해 줘야겠다. 놓쳐서 아쉬워하겠지, 분명.
Queen's Recruit#146.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#147.src: Oi, there! Are those my two favorite customers I see?
Queen's Recruit#147.dst: 어이, 거기! 내가 제일 좋아하는 손님 둘 아닌가?
Queen's Recruit#147.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#148.src: You call everyone your favorite customer, captain! Don't think I didn't notice!
Queen's Recruit#148.dst: 선장님은 누구한테나 제일 좋아하는 손님이라잖아요! 모를 줄 알았어요?
Queen's Recruit#148.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#149.src: Eheheheh, well, it's true, ain't it? I got lots o' favorites! Ah, anyhow, you're here for a trip, ain't'cha?
Queen's Recruit#149.dst: 에헤헤헤, 그래도 사실이잖아? 좋아하는 손님이 많은 거지! 아, 그나저나 배 타러 왔지?
Queen's Recruit#149.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#150.src: We are! You've... probably heard the details already? There should have been something about a new destination.
Queen's Recruit#150.dst: 네! 아마... 벌써 들으셨죠? 새 목적지에 대한 얘기가 있었을 텐데요.
Queen's Recruit#150.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#151.src: Aye. That I have. Some scrawny {p} courier wooshed past earlier! I barely got a word in before he was off again! Real interesting fellow.
Queen's Recruit#151.dst: 그래. 들었지. 아까 삐쩍 마른 {p} 전령이 휙 지나가더라고! 한마디 하기도 전에 사라졌어! 재밌는 녀석이야.
Queen's Recruit#151.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#152.src: ... Not a part o' the sea I like to visit, but I reckon I can make an exception this time.
Queen's Recruit#152.dst: ...내가 즐겨 가는 바다는 아니지만, 이번엔 예외로 해 주지.
Queen's Recruit#152.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#153.src: Hm... I can pay you extra for the trip, if you'd like.
Queen's Recruit#153.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#154.src: Ha! No, no, there's no need for that. It's free of charge for my two favorite customers, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#154.dst: 하! 아냐, 아냐, 그럴 필요 없어. 제일 좋아하는 손님 둘은 공짜야, 에헤!
Queen's Recruit#154.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#155.src: ...and, 'course, s'all paid for from {p}'s royal coffers anyhow. Now, hop on abour 'fore I change my mind and leave without ya!
Queen's Recruit#155.dst: ...그리고 뭐, 어차피 {p} 왕실 금고에서 다 내는 거고. 자, 내 맘 바뀌어서 두고 가기 전에 얼른 타!
Queen's Recruit#155.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#157.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#157.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#158.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#158.dst: 좀 비현실적이지 않아? Wynn에 막 돌아왔는데, 이젠... Fruma라니!
Queen's Recruit#158.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#159.src: Kind of make me wish we had Aledar here too. The three of us on an adventure again! Going back... home...
Queen's Recruit#159.dst: Aledar도 여기 있으면 좋겠다. 셋이 또 모험하는 거잖아! 돌아가는 거야... 고향으로...
Queen's Recruit#159.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#160.src: I guess we'll just have to tell him all about it when we get back. He'll be sad he missed it, I bet.
Queen's Recruit#160.dst: 돌아가면 전부 얘기해 줘야겠다. 놓쳐서 아쉬워하겠지, 분명.
Queen's Recruit#160.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#161.src: Oi, there! Are those my two favorite customers I see?
Queen's Recruit#161.dst: 어이, 거기! 내가 제일 좋아하는 손님 둘 아닌가?
Queen's Recruit#161.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#162.src: You call everyone your favorite customer, captain! Don't think I didn't notice!
Queen's Recruit#162.dst: 선장님은 누구한테나 제일 좋아하는 손님이라잖아요! 모를 줄 알았어요?
Queen's Recruit#162.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#163.src: Eheheheh, well, it's true, ain't it? I got lots o' favorites! Ah, anyhow, you're here for a trip, ain't'cha?
Queen's Recruit#163.dst: 에헤헤헤, 그래도 사실이잖아? 좋아하는 손님이 많은 거지! 아, 그나저나 배 타러 왔지?
Queen's Recruit#163.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#164.src: We are! You've... probably heard the details already? There should have been something about a new destination.
Queen's Recruit#164.dst: 네! 아마... 벌써 들으셨죠? 새 목적지에 대한 얘기가 있었을 텐데요.
Queen's Recruit#164.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#165.src: Aye. That I have. Some scrawny {p} courier wooshed past earlier! I barely got a word in before he was off again! Real interesting fellow.
Queen's Recruit#165.dst: 그래. 들었지. 아까 삐쩍 마른 {p} 전령이 휙 지나가더라고! 한마디 하기도 전에 사라졌어! 재밌는 녀석이야.
Queen's Recruit#165.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#166.src: ... Not a part o' the sea I like to visit, but I reckon I can make an exception this time.
Queen's Recruit#166.dst: ...내가 즐겨 가는 바다는 아니지만, 이번엔 예외로 해 주지.
Queen's Recruit#166.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#167.src: Hm... I can pay you extra for the trip, if you'd like.
Queen's Recruit#167.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#168.src: Ha! No, no, there's no need for that. It's free of charge for my two favorite customers, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#168.dst: 하! 아냐, 아냐, 그럴 필요 없어. 제일 좋아하는 손님 둘은 공짜야, 에헤!
Queen's Recruit#168.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#169.src: ...and, 'course, s'all paid for from {p}'s royal coffers anyhow. Now, hop on abour 'fore I change my mind and leave without ya!
Queen's Recruit#169.dst: ...그리고 뭐, 어차피 {p} 왕실 금고에서 다 내는 거고. 자, 내 맘 바뀌어서 두고 가기 전에 얼른 타!
Queen's Recruit#169.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#171.src: ...so, Fruma, eh? I'd ask what business ya've got there, but... figure it's top secret.
Queen's Recruit#171.dst: ...그래, Fruma라고? 무슨 볼일인지 묻고 싶지만... 극비겠지.
Queen's Recruit#171.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#172.src: We've been... invited into the province. Supposedly, it's for some sort of celebration, but...
Queen's Recruit#172.dst: 그 지방에... 초대받았어요. 무슨 축제 때문이라는데, 그게...
Queen's Recruit#172.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#173.src: Mmn. Aye, knowin' the rumors... not the kind o' place to just invite folks in, is it?
Queen's Recruit#173.dst: 음. 그래, 소문을 생각하면... 사람을 쉽게 초대할 곳은 아니지?
Queen's Recruit#173.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#176.src: Tell me, what's on yer mind then? The both o' you. Speakin' thoughts out tends to make 'em easier to manage, in my experience.
Queen's Recruit#176.dst: 그럼 말해 봐, 무슨 생각을 하고 있어? 둘 다. 내 경험상, 생각은 입 밖에 내면 다루기가 쉬워지거든.
Queen's Recruit#176.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#177.src: Fruma went through all that trouble to erase our memories, to get rid of us... just to ask for us back out of nowhere.
Queen's Recruit#177.dst: Fruma는 그렇게 공들여 우리 기억을 지우고, 우릴 내쫓았어요... 그래 놓고 갑자기 돌아오라니.
Queen's Recruit#177.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#178.src: I don't know why they're doing it, but I'm worried there's more going on.
Queen's Recruit#178.dst: 왜 이러는지 모르겠지만, 뭔가 더 있는 것 같아 걱정돼요.
Queen's Recruit#178.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#179.src: I've not got more of a clue than either o' you, but I reckon that suspicion is warranted.
Queen's Recruit#179.dst: 나도 너희보다 아는 건 없지만, 그렇게 의심할 만하다고 봐.
Queen's Recruit#179.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#180.src: But don't let it consume you, aye? Some suspicion is healthy, but if it colors everything ya do, it'll hurt ya just as bad as naivety would. Keep an open mind.
Queen's Recruit#180.dst: 하지만 의심에 잡아먹히진 마, 알았지? 적당한 의심은 좋지만, 모든 걸 의심으로 물들이면 순진한 것만큼이나 해로워. 마음을 열어 둬.
Queen's Recruit#180.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#181.src: ...it's possible. I hope you're right, and it is all fine, and we are all overthinking it...
Queen's Recruit#181.dst: ...그럴 수도 있죠. 선장님 말이 맞고, 다 괜찮고, 우리가 괜히 걱정하는 거면 좋겠어요...
Queen's Recruit#181.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#182.src: But I can't let my guard down. Everything about this situation is screaming that something isn't right, and... I don't know what.
Queen's Recruit#182.dst: 그래도 방심할 순 없어요. 이 상황 전부가 뭔가 잘못됐다고 외치는데... 그게 뭔지 모르겠어요.
Queen's Recruit#182.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#183.src: Nothin' wrong with hopin' for the best. Stayin' positive is all ya can really do, sometimes.
Queen's Recruit#183.dst: 좋은 쪽을 바라는 건 나쁜 게 아냐. 때로는 긍정적으로 사는 게 할 수 있는 전부지.
Queen's Recruit#183.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#184.src: Out here on the sea, we have a saying... go searchin' for the storm, and it'll find ya itself. Don't expect the worst, or it'll find a way to come to pass.
Queen's Recruit#184.dst: 바다에선 이런 말이 있어... 폭풍을 찾아다니면, 폭풍이 널 찾아온다. 최악을 예상하지 마, 그럼 정말 그렇게 되니까.
Queen's Recruit#184.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#185.src: ...home? Home. I guess. It'll be nice to have more memories of it than just... you know. Curses, and all that.
Queen's Recruit#185.dst: ...고향? 고향. 그런가 봐요. 그냥... 그런 거 말고 기억이 더 있으면 좋겠어요. 저주 같은 거요.
Queen's Recruit#185.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#186.src: Linton and Kymer are in W{~}.

similar.text: Linton and Kymer are in W2.

Queen's Recruit#187.src: Hm. I don’t got much of a home to get back to, either. Had it taken from me by those I trusted, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#187.dst: 흠. 나도 돌아갈 고향은 별로 없어. 믿었던 놈들한테 빼앗겼거든, 에헤!
Queen's Recruit#187.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#188.src: ... But, I made my own home, out here on the sea. Think even if I could go back now, I wouldn’t!
Queen's Recruit#188.dst: ...그래도, 여기 바다에 내 집을 만들었지. 지금 돌아갈 수 있대도 안 돌아갈 거야!
Queen's Recruit#188.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#189.src: So, if y’don’t like what ya find... don’t feel forced to take it, y’hear?
Queen's Recruit#189.dst: 그러니까, 거기서 본 게 맘에 안 들면... 억지로 받아들이지 마, 알았지?
Queen's Recruit#189.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#190.src: ...I'll keep that in mind. Thank you, captain.
Queen's Recruit#190.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#191.src: Ah, it's what I'm here for, ain't it? Givin' sage advice and salin' folks around the sea!
Queen's Recruit#191.dst: 아, 그게 내 일 아니겠어? 좋은 조언 해 주고 사람들 바다 건너 태워 주는 거!
Queen's Recruit#191.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#192.src: And look at that, on the horizon! Shinin' opulent docks... seems we've arrived.
Queen's Recruit#192.dst: 저기 봐, 수평선에! 번쩍이는 호화 부두라니... 다 온 모양이야.
Queen's Recruit#192.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#193.src: Dunno what you'll be facin' in there... but good luck anyway, aye?
Queen's Recruit#193.dst: 거기서 뭘 마주할진 모르겠지만... 아무튼 행운을 빌어, 응?
Queen's Recruit#193.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#194.src: We'll need it. Thanks for bringing us here, captain.
Queen's Recruit#194.dst: 행운이 필요할 거예요. 데려다줘서 고마워요, 선장님.
Queen's Recruit#194.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#196.src: It's... impressive. To build something like this for a gate no one ever uses...
Queen's Recruit#196.dst: 이거... 대단하다. 아무도 안 쓰는 관문을 이렇게 짓다니...
Queen's Recruit#196.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#197.src: I guess they have the resources to spare.
Queen's Recruit#197.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#198.src: Meet up with the group at the gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#199.src: Finally! The stragglers arrive. You certainly took your time, didn't you?
Queen's Recruit#199.dst: 드디어! 낙오자들이 오는군. 참 느긋하게도 왔구먼?
Queen's Recruit#199.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#201.src: Not the time, Kymer. Leave the poor man be for an hour, eh? Got bigger fish to fry, n' all that.
Queen's Recruit#201.dst: 지금 그럴 때가 아냐, Kymer. 한 시간만이라도 놔둬, 응? 더 급한 일이 있잖냐.
Queen's Recruit#201.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#202.src: Yes, yes, fine. We've not been able to get a word out of any of these soldiers! Do we even have the right time and place?
Queen's Recruit#202.dst: 그래, 그래, 알았네. 이 병사들한텐 한마디도 못 들었어! 시간과 장소가 맞긴 한 건가?
Queen's Recruit#202.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#203.src: Nah, you just haven't been trying hard enough. Hey, tin can! This is Fruma, right?
Queen's Recruit#203.dst: 에이, 덜 열심히 해서 그래. 어이, 깡통! 여기 Fruma 맞지?
Queen's Recruit#203.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#207.src: It really is an impressive construction, isn't it? All this for a closed-off province.
Queen's Recruit#207.dst: 정말 대단한 건축물이죠? 닫힌 지방에 이렇게까지.
Queen's Recruit#207.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#208.src: Impressive or not, we have work to do! On your guard, everyone. We don't know what to expect, so watch your backs.
Queen's Recruit#208.dst: 대단하든 말든, 할 일이 있어요! 다들 경계해요. 뭐가 나올지 모르니 뒤를 조심해요.
Queen's Recruit#208.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#209.src: S'anyone's guess when they'll actually let us in...
Queen's Recruit#209.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#212.src: Soldiers of Wynn! Her Majesty welcomes you to the province, as guests of the crown!
Queen's Recruit#212.dst: Wynn의 병사들이여! 여왕 폐하께서 왕실의 손님으로 여러분을 환영하십니다!
Queen's Recruit#212.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#213.src: Follow me, and you will be escorted to the royal palace. Let's not keep her waiting you all are of great importance to her.
Queen's Recruit#213.dst: 저를 따라오시면 왕궁까지 호위해 드리겠습니다. 폐하를 기다리게 하지 맙시다- 여러분은 폐하께 아주 중요하니까요.
Queen's Recruit#213.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#214.src: Listen to the introduction. Go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to return to the palace.

Queen's Recruit#215.src: Fruma's... a lot bigger than what I saw in my memories...
Queen's Recruit#215.dst: Fruma가... 내 기억에서 본 것보다 훨씬 크네...
Queen's Recruit#215.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#216.src: I guess that makes sense. I probably didn't travel much, back then. But... still.
Queen's Recruit#216.dst: 그럴 만도 하지. 그땐 별로 돌아다니지 않았을 테니까. 그래도... 좀.
Queen's Recruit#216.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#218.src: It... was. I don't know what I expected going in, but... it was stunning.
Queen's Recruit#218.dst: 그랬... 지. 뭘 기대했는지 모르겠지만... 굉장했어.
Queen's Recruit#218.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#219.src: Ha! Yeah, you know, I think you're right. It was impressive, but Gavel also has impressive sights.
Queen's Recruit#219.dst: 하! 그래, 네 말이 맞는 것 같아. 인상적이긴 했지만, Gavel에도 멋진 풍경은 있지.
Queen's Recruit#219.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#220.src: But let's not get distracted. The tour felt very... controlled. We were never let out of the carriages, and the Sovereign was keeping a watchful eye on us.
Queen's Recruit#220.dst: 그래도 한눈팔진 말자. 투어가 너무... 통제된 느낌이었어. 마차에서 한 번도 못 내렸고, 군주가 계속 우릴 지켜봤잖아.
Queen's Recruit#220.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#221.src: I'm interested in what they're choosing not to show us...
Queen's Recruit#221.dst: 오히려 안 보여 주기로 한 게 뭔지 궁금해...
Queen's Recruit#221.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#224.src: It is my honor as Queen to facilitate your return to our wonderful province. Though long you have spent away, you will always remain children of Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#224.dst: 여왕으로서 여러분이 이 멋진 지방으로 돌아오게 되어 영광입니다. 오래 떠나 있었어도, 여러분은 영원히 Fruma의 자녀입니다!
Queen's Recruit#224.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#225.src: Your work to battle against the blight beyond our walls has been of great interest. You have certainly made our province proud.
Queen's Recruit#225.dst: 벽 너머의 역병에 맞선 여러분의 활약은 큰 관심거리였습니다. 여러분은 분명 이 지방의 자랑입니다.
Queen's Recruit#225.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#226.src: You must have questions on the nature of your summons. All will be revealed but first, allow me to introduce two of my wonderful Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#226.dst: 소집된 이유가 궁금하겠지요. 모두 밝혀질 겁니다- 하지만 먼저, 훌륭한 군주 두 명을 소개하지요.
Queen's Recruit#226.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#227.src: You heard my name, but let me introduce myself. I am
Queen's Recruit#227.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#228.src: Majin of House Thalas, the Morning Star, Sovereign of our fair {p}. It's a pleasure, dear soldiers, to join our Queen for this ceremony!
Queen's Recruit#228.dst: Thalas 가문의 Majin, 샛별이자 아름다운 {p}의 군주랍니다. 친애하는 병사 여러분, 여왕 폐하와 이 의식을 함께하게 되어 기뻐요!
Queen's Recruit#228.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#230.src: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Sovereign of the {p}. The value of that title should speak for itself.
Queen's Recruit#230.dst: ...Zhiraok Nasin, {p}의 군주입니다. 그 칭호의 값은 굳이 말할 필요 없겠지요.
Queen's Recruit#230.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#231.src: Thank you, Sovereigns. These two, and the rest, are my council for ruling over our province. Each Sovereign is given governance over their own district, and works to serve the people there.
Queen's Recruit#231.dst: 고맙습니다, 군주들. 이 둘과 다른 군주들이 이 지방을 다스리는 제 의회입니다. 각 군주는 자기 구역을 맡아 그곳 백성을 위해 일합니다.
Queen's Recruit#231.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#232.src: There are others. Though, none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#232.dst: 다른 사람들도 있습니다. 하지만 아무도 이번 행사에는 올 수 없었죠 - 다들 여러 임무로 바쁘거든요.
Queen's Recruit#232.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#233.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W{~}... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#233.dst: 아, 여기 있군. Tasim과 {u}, 너희는 W{~}호실이야... 서쪽 동에 있지.

Queen's Recruit#234.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#234.dst: 내가 빠르고 은밀하니까. 이제 가 봐야 해, 경비병 눈에 띄고 싶지 않거든. 기억해, W{~}호실!

Queen's Recruit#236.src: There are others. Though none could attend this event they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#236.dst: 다른 군주들도 있습니다. 하지만 아무도 이번 행사에는 올 수 없었죠- 다들 여러 임무로 바쁘거든요.
Queen's Recruit#236.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#237.src: Enough of the boring talk! It is time for the welcoming feast!
Queen's Recruit#237.dst: 지루한 얘기는 이만! 환영 연회 시간입니다!
Queen's Recruit#237.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#238.src: We would like to share a taste of what our province has to deliver. Please find your way to the grand dining hall, situated just behind me.
Queen's Recruit#238.dst: 이 지방이 내놓을 수 있는 맛을 보여 드리고 싶군요. 제 뒤편의 대연회장으로 가 주십시오.
Queen's Recruit#238.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#239.src: Head to the royal dining hall at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#240.src: Make your way to the dining hall, the Queen will be starting her speech soon.
Queen's Recruit#240.dst: 연회장으로 가십시오. 여왕 폐하의 연설이 곧 시작됩니다.
Queen's Recruit#240.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#241.src: ...you can't even follow the order of operations while Her Majesty is watching?! What kind of expected value must the recruits ha
Queen's Recruit#241.dst: ...폐하께서 보시는데 연산 순서도 못 따라가오?! 신병들 기댓값이 대체 얼마나-
Queen's Recruit#241.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#242.src: Now, now, Nasin, settle down. We wouldn't want to leave a poor impression on our guest, would we?
Queen's Recruit#242.dst: 자, 자, Nasin, 진정하시죠. 손님께 나쁜 인상을 남기면 안 되잖아요?
Queen's Recruit#242.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#243.dst: 내 수열 좀 그만 끊으시오, 위선-
Queen's Recruit#243.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#244.src: Oh, you. You should report to the dining hall with the remainder of your group.

Queen's Recruit#244.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#245.src: Yes, yes, move along. You certainly don't want to keep Her Majesty waiting!

Queen's Recruit#248.src: You have all grown in your time spent beyond our walls, and what better way to show it?

Queen's Recruit#250.src: However, for whichever of you finds themselves crowned winner... a greater reward awaits. The specifics shall be revealed once the tournament has concluded.
Queen's Recruit#250.dst: 하지만 우승자로 오르는 분에게는... 더 큰 보상이 기다립니다. 자세한 내용은 대회가 끝나면 밝히겠습니다.

Queen's Recruit#252.src: ...very well. Accommodations shall be made. A different request may be made of you later, in exchange.

Queen's Recruit#253.src: I thank you for your grace and understanding, your majesty.
Queen's Recruit#253.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#254.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#255.src: Ah! It seems the first course has been prepared! Please, enjoy our province's finest cuisine.

Queen's Recruit#268.src: Talk about a fancy feast, huh?
