Queen's Recruit#333.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#334.src: Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
Queen's Recruit#334.dst: 그래, 그러고 보니 Picard, 아까 연회장에서 그건 뭐였나? 빠지겠다고 하면 오히려 눈에 띌 텐데?
Queen's Recruit#334.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#335.src: Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
Queen's Recruit#335.dst: 아니, 날 그런 전투 상황에 넣어서 뭐 하게요?! 그 틀 밖에서 궁을 자유롭게 둘러보는 게 훨씬 쓸모 있어요.
Queen's Recruit#335.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#336.src: And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention
Queen's Recruit#336.dst: 게다가 연구 노트 요약을 내라고 해서 완전히 자유로운 것도 아니에요, 말할 것도 없이-
Queen's Recruit#336.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#337.src: Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
Queen's Recruit#337.dst: 자, 다들 진정해! 시간 없다며? 얘기가 샜어. 부자고, 화려하고, 무슨 이유로 우릴 싸우게 하려고 해. 또 뭐 있어?
Queen's Recruit#337.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#338.src: ...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted- I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
Queen's Recruit#338.dst: ...무례하게 끊기기 전에 하던 말인데- 대회에서는 아직 건질 게 별로 없다고 봐요. 나중에 맞춰야 할 퍼즐 조각이죠.
Queen's Recruit#338.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#339.src: Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
Queen's Recruit#339.dst: 여왕과 군주들에 대해 알아낸 게 있나요? 흥미로운 통치 구조예요. 여왕에게 바로 닿는 통로가 있다는 건 구역들한테 가치가 있겠죠.
Queen's Recruit#339.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#340.src: Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
Queen's Recruit#340.dst: 음, 딱 봐도 연기하고 있어. 분명 뭔가 숨기고 있고, 말만큼 우릴 반기는 사람은 하나도 없는 것 같아.
Queen's Recruit#340.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#341.src: Yes, indeed... we were sent to Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
Queen's Recruit#341.dst: 맞아... 우린 영예로운 병사가 아니라 추방자로 Wynn에 보내졌어. 그런데 왜 아닌 척하지? 우릴 다시 부른 건 저쪽인데.
Queen's Recruit#341.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#342.src: Ah! Perhaps they're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
Queen's Recruit#342.dst: 아! 우리가 기억 주문을 풀었다는 걸 모르는 걸지도요? 저들이 보기엔, 우린 아직 거짓말을 믿고 있는 거죠.
Queen's Recruit#342.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#343.src: It'd explain some things, for certain...
Queen's Recruit#343.dst: 그럼 설명되는 게 좀 있긴 하네...
Queen's Recruit#343.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#344.src: So am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
Queen's Recruit#344.dst: 그런데 경비병 수가 이상하다고 느끼는 게 나뿐이야?
Queen's Recruit#344.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#345.src: You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be placed under more watchful eyes.
Queen's Recruit#345.dst: 낯선 사람 아홉이 왕궁에 들어왔으면 더 삼엄하게 감시할 줄 알았는데.
Queen's Recruit#345.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#346.src: Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
Queen's Recruit#346.dst: 그러고 보니... 방으로 오는 길에 본 경비병은 안뜰 출구에만 있었어. 방 앞엔 아무도 없어.
Queen's Recruit#346.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#347.src: ...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
Queen's Recruit#347.dst: ...그럼 몰래 다니는 거 안 해도 되는 거야?
Queen's Recruit#347.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#349.src: Seems likely to me they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#349.dst: 내가 보기엔 우리가 안전하고 신뢰받는다고 느끼게 하려는 것 같구먼. 우리가 본 걸 전부 얘기할 거란 걸 알 테니, 좋은 인상을 남기려는 거 아니겠어?
Queen's Recruit#349.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#350.src: A strong spell should get through this wood without a problem.
Queen's Recruit#350.dst: 강한 주문이면 이 나무쯤은 문제없이 뚫을 수 있을 것이다.

Queen's Recruit#351.src: Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
Queen's Recruit#351.dst: 게다가, 군주 둘이 우릴 지켜보잖냐. 꽤 강하지 않냐? 말썽 피우지 말라는 경고로는 그걸로 충분하겠지.
Queen's Recruit#351.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#352.src: Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards by extension anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
Queen's Recruit#352.dst: 군주 얘기가 나와서 말인데... 경비병도 그렇고- 마나 읽는 데 능한 사람 있어? 마나를 쓰는 기색이 거의 없어!
Queen's Recruit#352.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#353.src: I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
Queen's Recruit#353.dst: 그 얘기 하려던 참이에요. 마법사를 한 명도 못 봤어요. 가장 가까운 게 마법 무기를 든 고위 병사들이었죠.
Queen's Recruit#353.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#354.src: I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something wrong with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
Queen's Recruit#354.dst: 난 마나를 잘 읽진 못하지만... 군주들한테 뭔가 이상한 게 있어. 엄청나게 강한 기운에 둘러싸여 있어. 뭔가... 부자연스러워.
Queen's Recruit#354.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#355.src: Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
Queen's Recruit#355.dst: 네, 맞아요. 그 둘과 여왕만이 여기서 타고난 마법 능력을 가진 사람들이에요. 오히려 셋 다 에너지 면에서 밀접하게 연결된 것 같아요...
Queen's Recruit#355.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#356.src: As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
Queen's Recruit#356.dst: 흥미롭긴 한데, 나머지 우리가 파고들 건 별로 없네요. 박사님, 우릴 여기 모은 건 박사님이잖아요. 계획이 뭐예요?
Queen's Recruit#356.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#357.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them- though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#357.dst: 네, 제가 그렇죠... 음, 가장 유력한 단서는 군주들인 것 같습니다. 그들에게 집중해야겠지만- 일반 정보도 소홀히 하지 마세요. Fruma에 대해 가능한 한 많이 알아야 하니까요.
Queen's Recruit#357.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#358.src: We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
Queen's Recruit#358.dst: 오래 얘기했으니 오늘은 여기까지 하죠. 다들 쉬어요, 내일 최상의 상태여야 하니까요.
Queen's Recruit#358.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#359.src: Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
Queen's Recruit#359.dst: 내일 저녁에 여기서 다시 모여 회의합시다. 다들 잘 자요.
Queen's Recruit#359.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#360.src: Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.

Queen's Recruit#361.src: Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
Queen's Recruit#361.dst: 그 군주들... 신경 쓰이는군. Fruma의 지도층이 그만한 힘을 가졌다면...
Queen's Recruit#361.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#362.src: Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
Queen's Recruit#362.dst: 흠. 폐하께서 그들 비위를 거스르지 않으려는 게 옳을지도.
Queen's Recruit#362.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#363.src: Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
Queen's Recruit#363.dst: 아, 좋구먼, 이제 다들 눌러앉았네. 내 방에서 나가! 너희가 안 나가면 한숨도 못 자...
Queen's Recruit#363.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#364.src: ...damned Doctor should'a just used his own room!!
Queen's Recruit#364.dst: ...망할 박사, 자기 방을 쓰면 될 것을!!
Queen's Recruit#364.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#365.src: ...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#365.dst: ...휴. 난 여기서 뭘 하는 거지? {p}에 남았어야 했는데.
Queen's Recruit#365.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#366.src: I just hope nobody here knew me before. I'm not sure I could handle that.
Queen's Recruit#366.dst: 여기 옛날의 날 아는 사람이 없길 바랄 뿐이야. 그건 감당 못 할 것 같아.
Queen's Recruit#366.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#367.src: Hm... a shame I could not fight in the tournament. A monetary reward would be appreciated, given my dwindling research funds...
Queen's Recruit#367.dst: 흠... 대회에 못 나가서 아쉽네요. 연구 자금이 줄어드는 판에, 상금이면 고마웠을 텐데...
Queen's Recruit#367.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#368.src: But, alas, I am no fighter. Perhaps the King would be willing to fund my future research...
Queen's Recruit#368.dst: 하지만, 아아, 난 싸움꾼이 아니죠. 어쩌면 국왕께서 앞으로의 연구를 지원해 주실지도...
Queen's Recruit#368.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#369.src: Gosh, I hope my match tomorrow goes well. I'm a bit nervous... never really dueled anyone before!
Queen's Recruit#369.dst: 아이고, 내일 경기 잘 풀렸으면 좋겠다. 좀 긴장돼... 누구랑 제대로 결투해 본 적이 없거든!
Queen's Recruit#369.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#371.src: What? It's been a long day.
Queen's Recruit#371.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#372.src: That magic... why does it feel familiar? I can't pinpoint what it is, but...
Queen's Recruit#372.dst: 그 마법... 왜 익숙하게 느껴질까요? 뭔지 짚어낼 수는 없지만...
Queen's Recruit#372.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#373.src: Let's just go get some sleep.
Queen's Recruit#373.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#374.src: Goodnight, {u}. I hope you'll sleep better than I will.
Queen's Recruit#374.dst: 잘 자, {u}. 나보단 잘 자길 바라.
Queen's Recruit#374.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#376.src: {u}! We're going to miss the first round if you sleep any longer!
Queen's Recruit#376.dst: {u}! 더 자면 우리 첫 라운드 놓친다고!
Queen's Recruit#376.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#379.src: Well, I feel your pain. I don't think I got more than an hour or two. I kept... I should have expected it'd be worse here. I just hoped... well, it is what it is.
Queen's Recruit#379.dst: 그 마음 알아. 난 한두 시간도 못 잔 것 같아. 계속... 여기선 더 심할 거라고 예상했어야 했는데. 그냥 바랐지... 뭐, 어쩔 수 없지.
Queen's Recruit#379.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#380.src: But anyway, it's good you're up. A soldier just came by to tell us to head over to the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#380.dst: 아무튼 일어나서 다행이다. 방금 병사가 와서 대회 투기장으로 오라고 했어.
Queen's Recruit#380.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#381.src: You... no, they just... knocked and slid the notice under the door.
Queen's Recruit#381.dst: 네가... 아니, 그냥... 노크하고 문 밑으로 쪽지를 밀어 넣었어.
Queen's Recruit#381.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#382.src: Was someone in our room during the night...?
Queen's Recruit#382.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#383.src: I don't... like... that. Not at all.
Queen's Recruit#383.dst: 그거... 싫다... 정말. 전혀 안 좋아.
Queen's Recruit#383.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#384.src: Still. We need to head over to the arena. Apparently, it's in the northern part of the palace.
Queen's Recruit#384.dst: 그래도. 투기장으로 가야 해. 왕궁 북쪽에 있대.
Queen's Recruit#384.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#385.src: Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#386.src: Well, well. Looks like we'll finally get to test which o' us is stronger, eh, captain?
Queen's Recruit#386.dst: 자, 자. 드디어 누가 더 센지 가려 볼 수 있겠구먼, 응, 대장?
Queen's Recruit#386.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#387.src: Oh, finally? I wasn't aware there was even a question! Lieutenant, do you truly think you stand a chance against me?
Queen's Recruit#387.dst: 오, 드디어? 그게 가릴 문제인 줄도 몰랐군! 중위, 정말 날 이길 가망이 있다고 생각하나?
Queen's Recruit#387.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#388.src: Ah, enough o' your posturin', Kymer! You might be all up n' fancy these days, but I still remember when you were but a rookie, all afraid of a lil' old zombie!
Queen's Recruit#388.dst: 아, 폼 좀 그만 잡아, Kymer! 요즘은 잘나가는지 몰라도, 네가 신참 시절 늙은 좀비 하나에 벌벌 떨던 거 난 기억한다!
Queen's Recruit#388.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#389.src: Ha! Ah, good times. Good times. You'll get your recognition too one of these days, you know. Maybe you'll even surpass my rank someday!
Queen's Recruit#389.dst: 하! 아, 좋은 시절이었지. 좋은 시절. 자네도 언젠가 인정받을 걸세. 언젠간 내 계급을 넘어설지도 모르지!
Queen's Recruit#389.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#390.src: Eh, you say that every time. Besides, the lower ranks suit me well. Don't think I'd do well with all that "responsibility" the big wigs put on your shoulders.
Queen's Recruit#390.dst: 에이, 맨날 그 소리. 게다가 낮은 계급이 나한테 맞아. 높으신 분들이 지우는 그 '책임'은 난 못 감당해.
Queen's Recruit#390.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#391.src: ...all that bein' said, you're still goin' down when it's our go! I got some new tricks since the last time we fought, so don't get too cocky!
Queen's Recruit#391.dst: ...그건 그렇고, 우리 차례가 오면 넌 쓰러질 거다! 지난번 싸운 뒤로 새 기술 좀 익혔으니, 너무 까불지 마!
Queen's Recruit#391.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#392.src: Ha! Then I look forward to seeing them.
Queen's Recruit#392.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#393.src: If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
Queen's Recruit#393.dst: 대회 투기장을 찾으신다면, 이 복도로 내려가서 왼쪽으로 도십시오.
Queen's Recruit#393.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#394.src: The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#394.dst: 대회 투기장은 복도 더 안쪽에 있습니다.
Queen's Recruit#394.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#395.src: This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
Queen's Recruit#395.dst: 안타깝게도 이 구역은 지금 출입할 수 없습니다.
Queen's Recruit#395.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#396.src: This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
Queen's Recruit#396.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#397.src: I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until
Queen's Recruit#397.dst: 아직은 들여보내 드릴 수 없습니다. 그 전에-
Queen's Recruit#397.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#398.src: Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
Queen's Recruit#398.dst: 네, 네, 연구 노트요, 알아요. 이미 정리했어요. 이제 도서관 가도 돼요?
Queen's Recruit#398.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#399.src: Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
Queen's Recruit#399.dst: 끊지 마십시오. 이번 대회 경기가 끝나야 들어갈 수 있습니다. 여왕 폐하의 명입니다.
Queen's Recruit#399.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#400.src: Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
Queen's Recruit#400.dst: 흥. 좋아요! 좋아, 네, 기다리죠. 원 참.
Queen's Recruit#400.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#401.src: You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't want to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
Queen's Recruit#401.dst: 좀 자유가 있을 줄 알았는데, 없네요! 할 것도 없는데 경기 안 보고 싶다는 게 뭐가 문제죠?!
Queen's Recruit#401.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#402.src: Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
Queen's Recruit#402.dst: 아, 얼른 가서 경기나 끝내요. 꾸물대지 말고.
Queen's Recruit#402.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#404.src: Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#404.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#405.src: The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
Queen's Recruit#405.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#406.src: Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
Queen's Recruit#406.dst: 어. Majin... 군주? Majin 군주. 다 모였어요.
Queen's Recruit#406.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#407.src: My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
Queen's Recruit#407.dst: 어머, 이제야! 왕실의 손님이라면 이런 자리엔 제시간에 오는 게 좋지 않겠어요? 지각은 보기 안 좋답니다.
Queen's Recruit#407.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#408.src: Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance a humble mistake, I'm certain.
Queen's Recruit#408.dst: 죄송합니다, 군주님. 미리 올 시간을 안내받지 못한 것 같습니다- 사소한 실수겠지요.
Queen's Recruit#408.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#409.src: Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
Queen's Recruit#409.dst: 아, 아랫것들의 무능이란... 언제 봐도 놀랍네요! 그래도 제시간에 올 책임은 여러분에게 있어요. 다음엔 더 잘하세요, 네?
Queen's Recruit#409.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#410.src: Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
Queen's Recruit#410.dst: 자, 전 무척 바쁜 사람이니 짧게 하죠. 여왕 폐하께서 말씀하셨듯, 이 대회는 여러 번의 결투로 이뤄집니다! 경기를 전부 볼 필요는 없어요.
Queen's Recruit#410.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#411.src: The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena - though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
Queen's Recruit#411.dst: 기본 규칙대로입니다. 살해 금지, 불구 금지, 투기장 밖 공격 금지- 뭐, 해 보세요, 실패하는 꼴을 보면 아주 즐거울 테니!
Queen's Recruit#411.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#412.src: With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is
Queen's Recruit#412.dst: 그럼, 질문 있나요? 없길 바라요, 이게 끝나면 돌아가서 할 일이-
Queen's Recruit#412.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#413.src: Ah, I do I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
Queen's Recruit#413.dst: 아, 저요- 전 대회에 안 나가요. 오늘 다른 걸 준비해 준다고 들었는데요.
Queen's Recruit#413.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#414.src: Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
Queen's Recruit#414.dst: 아, 그래... 당신. 뭐라고 했죠, 무슨... 연구원?
Queen's Recruit#414.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#415.src: Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#415.dst: 아하하하! 오, 그런데 당신네 지방 최고 인재로 뽑혔다고요? 웃기지 마세요! 아하하하하!
Queen's Recruit#415.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#416.src: Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
Queen's Recruit#416.dst: 아, 그래도 차라리 잘됐네요. 아홉 명은 대회에 딱 맞지 않거든요. 아홉 번째 전사보다는 연구원이 낫죠!
Queen's Recruit#416.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#417.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do- you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#417.dst: 네, 곧 누가 와서 도와줄 겁니다. 옆에 앉아서 손가락이나 돌리든지, 뭘 하든지 하세요- 이제 당신은 제 알 바가 아니니까요.
Queen's Recruit#417.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#423.src: Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
Queen's Recruit#423.dst: 훌륭해요! 첫 대진은... {u}와 Mel이군요. 두 사람, 앞으로.
Queen's Recruit#423.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#426.src: Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
Queen's Recruit#426.dst: 자, 서둘러 준비하세요! 북쪽이든 남쪽이든 복도를 하나씩 골라서 어서 싸우세요!
Queen's Recruit#426.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#427.src: As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
Queen's Recruit#427.dst: 나머지는... 아, 귀찮네요. 대진은 게시판에서 알아서 보세요.
Queen's Recruit#427.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#428.src: Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
Queen's Recruit#428.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#429.src: Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.

Queen's Recruit#431.src: Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
Queen's Recruit#431.dst: 여기 임무가 있다고 봐줄 거라 생각하지 마!
Queen's Recruit#431.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#432.src: Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
Queen's Recruit#432.dst: 준비됐어?! 우리 실력 좀 보여 주자!
Queen's Recruit#432.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#433.src: Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
Queen's Recruit#433.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#434.src: What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
Queen's Recruit#434.dst: 내 기술 어땠어? 괜찮지? 덕분에 싸울 때 가만히 얻어맞지만은 않거든!
Queen's Recruit#434.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#435.src: Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
Queen's Recruit#435.dst: 아, 난 뭘 이길 거라곤 생각 안 했어. 그래도 도전해 보니 재밌었다.
Queen's Recruit#435.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#436.src: {u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
Queen's Recruit#436.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#438.src: You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
Queen's Recruit#438.dst: 대회 기간 동안 왕궁에 머물 수 있습니다. 참가 보상은 체류가 끝날 때 지급됩니다.
Queen's Recruit#438.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#439.src: I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
Queen's Recruit#439.dst: 그럼 말이 되네. Lanu 경기는 언제일까...
Queen's Recruit#439.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#440.src: {u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
Queen's Recruit#440.dst: {u}님, 승리를 축하드립니다. 다음 경기는 따로 알려 드리겠습니다. 그동안 편히 쉬십시오.
Queen's Recruit#440.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#441.src: Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#442.src: It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
Queen's Recruit#442.dst: 좋은 싸움이었어! 대신 이제 내 몫까지 꼭 이겨야 한다, 알았지?
Queen's Recruit#442.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#443.src: We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
Queen's Recruit#443.dst: 다음 경기는 나중에 발표합니다. 그동안 편히 쉬시거나 왕궁을 둘러보십시오.
Queen's Recruit#443.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#444.src: Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
Queen's Recruit#444.dst: 아, {u}, 경기 봤어요! 기술이 아주 좋더군요. 제가 {p}에서 본 많은 병사들보다 나아요.
Queen's Recruit#444.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#445.src: I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
Queen's Recruit#445.dst: 하긴 놀랍지도 않네요! 대회가 발표됐을 때 우승 후보로 떠오른 게 당신이었거든요. 당신이랑, 한 사람 더요.
Queen's Recruit#445.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#446.src: Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#446.dst: 흠... 누가 이길지 내기라도 걸어 볼까... 아, 안 돼, 안 돼, 너무 바빠요. 집중해, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#446.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#447.src: Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
Queen's Recruit#447.dst: 응? 이런, 여기 있는 걸 깜빡했네요! 그래, 뭘 하려고 했는데...
Queen's Recruit#447.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#448.src: Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
Queen's Recruit#448.dst: 아! 도서관! 믿어져요? 그 망할 경비병이 드디어 자리를 떴어요! 말도 안 되죠- 대체 누가 도서관을 지켜요?!
Queen's Recruit#448.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#449.src: But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take the opportunity while I can!
Queen's Recruit#449.dst: 하지만. 하지만하지만하지만. 길이 열렸고, 대회 라운드는 아직 진행 중이지만, 기회 있을 때 잡고 싶어요!
Queen's Recruit#449.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#450.src: Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
Queen's Recruit#450.dst: 같이 갈래요? 분명 흥미로운 게 있을 거예요. Fruma 사람들이 이 벽 안에 어떤 지식을 숨겨 뒀을까...
Queen's Recruit#450.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#451.src: Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
Queen's Recruit#451.dst: 자, 올 거예요? 어서요, 빨리, 경비병이 돌아오기 전에!
Queen's Recruit#451.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#453.src: Goodness, where to even begin? There's so much here...
Queen's Recruit#453.dst: 세상에, 어디서부터 시작하죠? 여기 너무 많아요...
Queen's Recruit#453.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#454.src: I hereby introduce to you The Evermoving Zephyr, the ruler of the {p}, the latest in the line of one of Fruma's great noble houses! His lordship, Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin!
Queen's Recruit#454.dst: 이제 소개합니다. 멈추지 않는 산들바람, {p}의 통치자, Fruma 명문 귀족 가문의 최신 계승자! 각하, Zhiraok Nasin 군주!

Queen's Recruit#455.src: ...and that we're rifling through the Cursed instead of our own citizens is an incalculable risk!
Queen's Recruit#455.dst: ...그리고 우리 시민 대신 저주받은 자들을 뒤지는 건 계산할 수조차 없는 위험이오!

Queen's Recruit#456.src: What was that?! Quickly, quickly now, follow me!
Queen's Recruit#456.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#457.src: Do you have eyes on the speaker? Who is it?
Queen's Recruit#457.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#458.src: I can't find her angle for this hunt.
Queen's Recruit#458.dst: 이번 사냥에서 그녀의 각도를 못 구하겠소.
Queen's Recruit#458.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#459.src: Ah, it's like I'm talking with her again! It's so nostalgic to speak with a clueless Nasin trying their hardest, in spite of their incompe
Queen's Recruit#459.dst: 아, 마치 그녀와 다시 얘기하는 것 같네요! 아무것도 모르는 Nasin이 무능한데도 필사적으로 애쓰는 걸 보니 참 그립-
Queen's Recruit#459.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#460.src: I'M SORRY, YOU IGNORANT INTEGRAND? You really think now is the time for- Rrgh... Why. Do I even bother.
Queen's Recruit#460.dst: 뭐라고, 이 무지한 피적분 함수 같으니? 지금이 그럴 때라고- 크윽... 내가. 왜 상대를 하는지.
Queen's Recruit#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#461.src: Why, indeed! It truly is a bad habit. Something to work on while your seniors do the important work, hm?
Queen's Recruit#461.dst: 그러게 말이에요! 정말 나쁜 버릇이죠. 선배들이 중요한 일을 하는 동안 고쳐 보세요, 네?
Queen's Recruit#461.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#462.src: Speaking of, I must put forth that I do find this all a bit strange. We most certainly aren't lacking in strength here, so why bother with the exiles?
Queen's Recruit#462.dst: 그 얘기가 나와서 말인데, 전 이 모든 게 좀 이상하다고 봐요. 여기 힘이 부족한 것도 아닌데, 왜 굳이 추방자들을?
Queen's Recruit#462.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#463.src: ...sigh... The risk factor is much greater than I'd bet on. She has to know more than we do, so maybe we'll get a summation later.
Queen's Recruit#463.dst: ...하아... 위험 계수가 내가 걸 만한 수준보다 훨씬 크오. 그녀가 우리보다 더 알 테니, 나중에 총합을 받을지도.
Queen's Recruit#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#465.src: Ah, there she is. Fashionably late as always!
Queen's Recruit#465.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#466.src: Hm. If anything, I was early.

Queen's Recruit#467.src: I'd say your timing was golden- if you're here for that summation I mentioned, and this isn't anything else.
Queen's Recruit#467.dst: 시기가 황금비였다고 하겠소- 내가 말한 총합 때문에 온 거고, 다른 일이 아니라면.
Queen's Recruit#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#468.src: It's the former. But first, have you been watching the battles? Do any of the contestants stick out to you?
Queen's Recruit#468.dst: 앞의 것이다. 하지만 먼저, 결투는 보고 있었나? 눈에 띄는 참가자는?

Queen's Recruit#469.src: Stick out? Hardly. Thus far, I have been thoroughly unimpressed.
Queen's Recruit#469.dst: 눈에 띈다고요? 전혀요. 지금까지 전혀 감흥이 없었네요.
Queen's Recruit#469.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#470.src: Naturally you would be. I've seen some generally promising things, but I need to know the expected solution to narrow the pool
Queen's Recruit#470.dst: 당연히 그러시겠지. 대체로 유망한 건 좀 봤소만, 후보군을 좁히려면 기대 해를 알아야-
Queen's Recruit#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#471.src: Ah, ah! Settle down, Nasin, your betters are speaking. Calculate yourself out of dead last, first.
Queen's Recruit#471.dst: 아, 아! 진정해요, Nasin, 윗사람들이 말하잖아요. 꼴찌에서 벗어나는 계산부터 하세요.
Queen's Recruit#471.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#472.src: Later, then. We have problems. The contestants have been sneaking around. And the doctor has been taking meticulous notes.
Queen's Recruit#472.dst: 그럼 나중에. 문제가 생겼다. 참가자들이 몰래 돌아다니고 있어. 그리고 박사는 꼼꼼히 기록을 남기고 있지.

Queen's Recruit#473.src: ...looks like you letting him sit out the problem was a miscalculation, huh?
Queen's Recruit#473.dst: ...그를 이 문제에서 빼 준 게 오산이었나 보군?
Queen's Recruit#473.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#474.src: For once, we appear to be in agreement. What a pity, what a hassle... it hardly seems worth the effort to me.
Queen's Recruit#474.dst: 웬일로 의견이 같네요. 딱하고, 귀찮아라... 그렇게까지 애쓸 가치가 있나 싶어요.
Queen's Recruit#474.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#475.src: It will be. But I've spent too much time here already. You'll have to wait for answers.
Queen's Recruit#475.dst: 있을 거다. 하지만 여기 너무 오래 있었군. 답은 기다려야 할 거다.

Queen's Recruit#476.src: Of course. How much more irrational can we get, I wonder.
Queen's Recruit#476.dst: 물론이오. 우리가 얼마나 더 무리수가 될 수 있을지 궁금하군.
Queen's Recruit#476.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#477.src: If you'd like something to look out for, one of the more promising candidates is set to have a match soon. Go watch it.
Queen's Recruit#477.dst: 지켜볼 게 필요하다면, 유망한 후보 하나가 곧 경기를 한다. 가서 봐라.

Queen's Recruit#478.src: A joy as always. Well, you heard her, Nasin! Chop chop, off to the stands we go!
Queen's Recruit#478.dst: 언제나 즐겁네요. 자, 들었죠, Nasin! 어서어서, 관중석으로 가요!
Queen's Recruit#478.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#479.src: ...so not even the Sovereigns know what's happening. Fascinating. Very fascinating.
Queen's Recruit#479.dst: ...그러니까 군주들조차 무슨 일인지 모른다는 거군요. 흥미로워요. 아주 흥미로워요.
Queen's Recruit#479.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#480.src: And there was a third! Who were they? Another Sovereign...? Damn it, damn it all, how did I not notice?
Queen's Recruit#480.dst: 그리고 세 번째가 있었어요! 누구였죠? 또 다른 군주...? 젠장, 젠장, 어떻게 눈치를 못 챘지?
Queen's Recruit#480.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#481.src: Well, they appear to be onto us. No matter. We'll need to be more careful.
Queen's Recruit#481.dst: 음, 우릴 눈치챈 것 같네요. 상관없어요. 더 조심해야겠어요.
Queen's Recruit#481.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#482.src: You'd best get back to the arena. In the meantime, I'll keep searching here... there must be something useful!
Queen's Recruit#482.dst: 투기장으로 돌아가는 게 좋겠어요. 그동안 난 여기서 계속 찾을게요... 분명 쓸 만한 게 있을 거예요!
Queen's Recruit#482.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#484.src: ...hm? Oh, yes, fine, I'll tell the rest about what we heard. After I'm done here, of course.
Queen's Recruit#484.dst: ...응? 아, 네, 알았어요, 들은 건 다른 사람들한테 말할게요. 물론 여기 일 끝나고요.
Queen's Recruit#484.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#485.src: The first round of the tournament has concluded!
Queen's Recruit#485.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#486.src: The names that will proceed to the next round... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#486.dst: 다음 라운드에 진출할 이름은... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#486.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#487.src: {u}, your match will begin shortly. Your opponent is already in the waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#487.dst: {u}님, 곧 경기가 시작됩니다. 상대는 이미 대기실에 있습니다.
Queen's Recruit#487.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#488.src: Make your way to the arena.
Queen's Recruit#488.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#489.src: Begin your next duel in the arena down the stairs.
Queen's Recruit#489.dst: 계단 아래 투기장에서 다음 결투를 시작하세요.

Queen's Recruit#490.src: Please make your way to the arena by following the stairs down.
Queen's Recruit#490.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#491.src: Please go to the waiting room and prepare for the battle.
Queen's Recruit#491.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#493.src: Well, you'll likely prove more of a challenge than Linton, that's for sure.
Queen's Recruit#493.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#494.src: You've come a long way since {p}, haven't you? Well, so have I! Let's battle.
Queen's Recruit#494.dst: {p} 이후로 많이 컸지? 뭐, 나도 그래! 붙어 보자.
Queen's Recruit#494.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#495.src: The battle is decided! {u} has come out victorious.
Queen's Recruit#495.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#496.src: Ah... good fighting, {u}. I even used some of my most powerful arrows.
Queen's Recruit#496.dst: 아... 잘 싸웠어, {u}. 가장 강한 화살까지 몇 발 썼는데.
Queen's Recruit#496.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#498.src: I know, I know. You were a worthy opponent, {u}. Now, you'll be winning this whole thing, yes?
Queen's Recruit#498.dst: 알아, 알아. 훌륭한 상대였어, {u}. 이제 전부 이겨 버릴 거지?
Queen's Recruit#498.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#499.src: {u}, congratulations on reaching the finals. All other opponents have been defeated, except for you and your fellow finalist.
Queen's Recruit#499.dst: {u}님, 결승 진출을 축하드립니다. 당신과 다른 결승 진출자를 제외한 모든 상대가 패배했습니다.
Queen's Recruit#499.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#500.src: Hmph. That will be announced shortly. Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#500.dst: 흠. 곧 발표될 겁니다. 안뜰로 가서 추가 지시를 기다리십시오.
Queen's Recruit#500.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#501.src: Return to the courtyard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] and find other contestants.

Queen's Recruit#502.src: I did well enough, I suppose. I'll be glad for this to all be over, anyway.
Queen's Recruit#502.dst: 그럭저럭 잘한 것 같아. 어쨌든 이게 다 끝나면 좋겠다.
Queen's Recruit#502.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#503.src: Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#503.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#504.src: {u}, you return! Well, how did your match go?
Queen's Recruit#504.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#505.src: You? I suppose that would make sense. No offense intended, Reynauld, but I would have bet on {u} if I had the chance.
Queen's Recruit#505.dst: 자네가? 뭐 그럴 만하지. 기분 나쁘게 듣지 말게, Reynauld. 기회가 있었다면 난 {u}에게 걸었을 걸세.
Queen's Recruit#505.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#506.src: Ha. For me, certainly! It felt like I could barely make a dent in your stamina.
Queen's Recruit#506.dst: 하. 나라도 그랬겠죠! 체력에 흠집 하나 못 낸 기분이었어요.
Queen's Recruit#506.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#507.src: Yes, yes, congratulations are in order, and all that we have problems.
Queen's Recruit#507.dst: 네, 네, 축하할 일이죠, 그건 그렇고- 문제가 생겼어요.
Queen's Recruit#507.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#508.src: It was problem enough that he was called here in the first place... to think, he could
Queen's Recruit#508.dst: 애초에 그가 여기 불려 온 것부터가 문제였지... 생각해 보게, 그가-
Queen's Recruit#508.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#509.src: That is enough about the tournament. I don't want to hear about it anymore. The doctor is right.
Queen's Recruit#509.dst: 대회 얘기는 그만해요. 더는 듣고 싶지 않아요. 박사님 말이 맞아요.
Queen's Recruit#509.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#510.src: Yes, well, it's not your honour on the line... but fine, I admit, this third Sovereign is... troubling.
Queen's Recruit#510.dst: 그래, 뭐, 자네 명예가 걸린 건 아니니까... 하지만 좋아, 인정하지. 세 번째 군주는... 골치 아프군.
Queen's Recruit#510.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#511.src: Hm. Have we been able to find the information we needed?
Queen's Recruit#511.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#512.src: No! And that is precisely our problem we are missing something, and we are running out of time! One final match, and then it's done.
Queen's Recruit#512.dst: 아뇨! 바로 그게 문제예요- 뭔가 놓치고 있는데, 시간이 없어요! 마지막 경기 하나면 끝이에요.
Queen's Recruit#512.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#513.src: ...truthfully, I'm surprised you were on my side for that match.
Queen's Recruit#513.dst: ...솔직히 그 경기에서 제 편을 들어 주실 줄은 몰랐어요.
Queen's Recruit#513.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#514.src: Ah, well, someone had t' take him down a peg! Guess that someone was you.
Queen's Recruit#514.dst: 아, 뭐, 누군가는 그놈 콧대를 꺾어야지! 그게 너였나 보다.
Queen's Recruit#514.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#515.src: Oh, give me a break, lieutenant. Him? Of all people to
Queen's Recruit#515.dst: 아, 좀 봐주게, 중위. 그 친구가? 하필이면-
Queen's Recruit#515.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#516.src: Hey, everyone's here! Is... this where they wanted everyone to gather up?
Queen's Recruit#516.dst: 어, 다들 여기 있네! 여기가... 모두 모이라던 곳이야?
Queen's Recruit#516.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#517.src: Seems that way. You won your match?
Queen's Recruit#517.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#518.src: I did. It seems I'm a finalist now. So, who's the other one?
Queen's Recruit#518.dst: 네. 이제 결승 진출자래요. 그럼, 다른 한 명은 누구예요?
Queen's Recruit#518.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#519.src: Oh! Well, congratulations! Though, I guess we'll be facing each other soon.
Queen's Recruit#519.dst: 아! 그럼, 축하해! 그래도 곧 서로 맞붙겠네.
Queen's Recruit#519.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#520.src: Good grief... yes, the tournament has happened, congratulations to the finalists, whatever where are Mel and Linton? We need to discuss what's next, before
Queen's Recruit#520.dst: 원 참... 그래, 대회는 끝났고, 결승 진출자들 축하하고, 됐고- Mel과 Linton은 어디 있죠? 다음 일을 의논해야 해요, 그 전에-
Queen's Recruit#520.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#521.src: ...and so, what, I'm not allowed to take a nap now? I wasn't even fighting!! Mel, back me up, come on!
Queen's Recruit#521.dst: ...그래서 뭐, 이제 낮잠도 못 자? 난 싸우지도 않았다고!! Mel, 편 좀 들어 줘, 응!
Queen's Recruit#521.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#522.src: He's right, this hardly seems fair! We were told we could stay in our rooms until the tournament had concluded, so why the change?!
Queen's Recruit#522.dst: Linton 말이 맞아, 이건 불공평해! 대회 끝날 때까진 방에 있어도 된다고 했잖아, 왜 바뀌었어?!
Queen's Recruit#522.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#524.src: Any competitors who have lost in the tournament are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#524.dst: 대회에서 패배한 참가자는 즉시 Fruma 밖으로 호송된다.
Queen's Recruit#524.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#525.src: what is the meaning of this?!
Queen's Recruit#525.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#526.src: SILENCE! These are new orders from Her Majesty.
Queen's Recruit#526.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#527.src: Only {u} and Tasim are permitted to remain in the palace. Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province.
Queen's Recruit#527.dst: {u}와 Tasim만 왕궁에 남는다. 거역하면 Wynn 지방이 Fruma에 가하는 공식 위협으로 간주한다.
Queen's Recruit#527.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#528.src: Comply, and no one will be hurt. You will still receive your promised reward for participation.
Queen's Recruit#528.dst: 따르면 아무도 다치지 않는다. 약속된 참가 보상은 그대로 받는다.
Queen's Recruit#528.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#530.src: Enough, Kymer. What's done is done. We have no choice.
Queen's Recruit#530.dst: 그만해요, Kymer. 엎질러진 물이에요. 선택지가 없어요.
Queen's Recruit#530.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#532.src: You two. Stay safe, and be on guard. I'll report back to the King with this news. If you're not released safely...
Queen's Recruit#532.dst: 자네 둘. 몸조심하고, 경계하게. 이 소식은 폐하께 보고하겠네. 자네들이 무사히 풀려나지 않으면...
Queen's Recruit#532.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#533.src: ...{u}. Tasim. I've gotten what I came here for originally, but... I don't know what they're planning. You'll have to handle it on your own.
Queen's Recruit#533.dst: ...{u}. Tasim. 원래 여기 온 목적은 이뤘지만... 저들이 뭘 꾸미는지 모르겠어요. 스스로 해결해야 할 거예요.
Queen's Recruit#533.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#535.src: Remaining finalists, you are expected in the dining hall shortly. Attend your last meal before the finals.
Queen's Recruit#535.dst: 남은 결승 진출자는 곧 연회장으로 오도록. 결승 전 마지막 식사에 참석하라.
Queen's Recruit#535.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#537.src: What was that? What just happened?
Queen's Recruit#537.dst: 방금 뭐였지? 무슨 일이 벌어진 거야?
Queen's Recruit#537.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#538.src: They've changed the rules on us, and now... ugh, we have no choice... We need to see it through.
Queen's Recruit#538.dst: 규칙을 바꿔 버렸고, 이제... 으, 선택지가 없어... 끝까지 가 보는 수밖에.
Queen's Recruit#538.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#539.src: Well... come on. Let's attend our final dinner here.
Queen's Recruit#539.dst: 자... 가자. 여기서의 마지막 저녁 먹으러.
Queen's Recruit#539.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#541.src: What are we supposed to do...?
Queen's Recruit#541.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#542.src: They'll let us out. They have to. It'd be a diplomatic disaster if they didn't.
Queen's Recruit#542.dst: 내보내 줄 거야. 그래야만 해. 안 그러면 외교적 재앙이니까.
Queen's Recruit#542.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#544.src: If you were not already aware, your fellow soldiers have been returned to Wynn. Safely.
Queen's Recruit#544.dst: 모르셨다면 말씀드리지요, 동료 병사들은 Wynn으로 돌려보냈습니다. 무사히.
Queen's Recruit#544.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#545.src: ...if you don't mind me asking, Your Majesty, I thought we had an agreement? We would all remain here until the tournament concluded with the finals.
Queen's Recruit#545.dst: ...여쭤도 된다면, 폐하, 약속이 있지 않았나요? 결승으로 대회가 끝날 때까지 모두 여기 머무르기로요.
Queen's Recruit#545.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#546.src: Oh? And would you like to join the rest of them? That could certainly be arranged we could simply select a victor here and now, and be done with this whole
Queen's Recruit#546.dst: 오? 그럼 당신도 그들과 함께 가고 싶나요? 얼마든지 가능하죠- 그냥 지금 여기서 우승자를 뽑고 이 모든 걸-
Queen's Recruit#546.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#547.src: What is your problem, Thalas?! They're guests of Her Majesty! How irrational are you, trying to subtract them without her appr
Queen's Recruit#547.dst: 대체 무슨 문제요, Thalas?! 폐하의 손님이오! 폐하 허락도 없이 빼 버리려 하다니 얼마나 비합리-
Queen's Recruit#547.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#549.src: To answer your question, the circumstances have changed. There is no need for the rest of your group to remain here.
Queen's Recruit#549.dst: 질문에 답하자면, 상황이 바뀌었습니다. 나머지 일행이 여기 남을 필요는 없습니다.
Queen's Recruit#549.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#550.src: The remainder of the tournament will proceed as expected.
Queen's Recruit#550.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#552.src: Good. Now, let us enjoy the meal!
Queen's Recruit#552.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#553.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported the {p}, and the vegetables came from the royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#553.dst: Fruma 요리를 한 번 더... 고기는 {p}에서 들여왔고, 채소는 왕실 정원에서 가져왔습니다.
Queen's Recruit#553.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#554.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported from the {p}, and the vegetables came from our royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#554.dst: Fruma 요리를 한 번 더... 고기는 {p}에서 들여왔고, 채소는 왕실 정원에서 가져왔습니다.
Queen's Recruit#554.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#555.src: Now, to business. The final will take place tomorrow morning. But first, I would like to speak to each of you individually.
Queen's Recruit#555.dst: 자, 본론입니다. 결승은 내일 아침에 열립니다. 하지만 먼저, 한 사람씩 따로 이야기하고 싶군요.
Queen's Recruit#555.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#556.src: Let us begin with... {u}. Please come to the north-eastern wing when you are ready.
Queen's Recruit#556.dst: 먼저... {u}부터 시작하죠. 준비되면 북동쪽 동으로 오십시오.
Queen's Recruit#556.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#558.src: Talk to Her Majesty in the north-eastern wing of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#558.dst: [-{~}, {~}, {~}]의 왕궁 북동쪽 동에서 여왕 폐하와 대화하세요.

Queen's Recruit#561.src: Well. I suppose congratulations are in order, finalist.
Queen's Recruit#561.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#562.src: You're curious, surely? For what purpose would I call you soldiers back to our province?
Queen's Recruit#562.dst: 궁금하겠지요? 무슨 목적으로 당신들 병사를 이 지방으로 불러들였는지.
Queen's Recruit#562.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#563.src: Certainly not for a vanity tournament. A meaningless celebration.
Queen's Recruit#563.dst: 허영 가득한 대회 때문은 분명 아닙니다. 무의미한 축제지요.
Queen's Recruit#563.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#564.src: Oh, let us drop the facade. I know what you have been doing in secret. I am not blind.
Queen's Recruit#564.dst: 아, 겉치레는 그만두지요. 몰래 무엇을 했는지 압니다. 저는 눈이 멀지 않았습니다.
Queen's Recruit#564.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#565.src: You chose this opportunity to seek out information on our province. What little you have learned, we have deemed an acceptable cost.
Queen's Recruit#565.dst: 당신들은 이 기회를 이 지방의 정보를 캐는 데 썼습니다. 알아낸 약간의 것은 감수할 만한 대가로 판단했습니다.
Queen's Recruit#565.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#566.src: Given the circumstances, I would have sacrificed much, much more if necessary.
Queen's Recruit#566.dst: 상황을 생각하면, 필요하다면 훨씬, 훨씬 더 많이 희생했을 겁니다.
Queen's Recruit#566.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#567.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers - a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#567.dst: Wynn 최고의 인재들이라... 범위가 넓죠. 인원을 줄여야 했고, 힘겨루기가 그 일을 훌륭히 해냈습니다.
Queen's Recruit#567.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#568.src: And now... two candidates remain. You have done well to make it this far. I have been watching the duels intently, and you are certainly not unimpressive.
Queen's Recruit#568.dst: 그리고 이제... 두 후보가 남았습니다. 여기까지 온 건 잘한 일입니다. 결투를 유심히 지켜봤는데, 당신도 분명 인상적이었습니다.
Queen's Recruit#568.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#569.src: Yet of the two of you... you certainly leave a lesser impression than him. You are one amongst hundreds, thousands... indistinguishable.
Queen's Recruit#569.dst: 하지만 둘 중에서는... 당신은 그보다 인상이 약합니다. 수백, 수천 중 하나일 뿐... 구별되지 않지요.
Queen's Recruit#569.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#570.src: And still, here you stand. It intrigues me. What is so special about you? What strength has led you here?
Queen's Recruit#570.dst: 그런데도 당신은 여기 서 있군요. 흥미롭습니다. 당신의 무엇이 특별하죠? 어떤 힘이 당신을 여기로 이끌었습니까?
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#571.src: But no matter. Answers will come with time... should you be selected. I can tell you have a question. Speak it.
Queen's Recruit#571.dst: 하지만 상관없습니다. 답은 때가 되면 옵니다... 당신이 선택된다면. 질문이 있어 보이는군요. 말해 보십시오.
Queen's Recruit#571.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#572.src: Hm. A blank slate... to be able to see the outside world, for all its splendor and all its faults, to witness firsthand the deep rooted seeds of its inevitable destruction... there is value to that.
Queen's Recruit#572.dst: 흠. 백지 상태라... 바깥세상을 볼 수 있다는 것, 그 모든 영광과 결함을, 필연적 파멸의 깊이 뿌리내린 씨앗을 직접 목격한다는 것... 거기엔 가치가 있습니다.
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#573.src: You have seen it, haven't you? Forces beyond any of us vie for control of our world, caring not for what destruction they instill.
Queen's Recruit#573.dst: 당신도 봤겠지요? 우리 모두를 넘어선 힘들이 세상의 지배권을 두고 다투며, 어떤 파괴를 낳든 개의치 않습니다.
Queen's Recruit#573.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#574.src: And it truly is a beautiful world, isn't it? To think, it could be destroyed, taken for their ceaseless war which holds no meaning, no purpose...
Queen's Recruit#574.dst: 그리고 정말 아름다운 세상이지 않습니까? 의미도 목적도 없는 끝없는 전쟁 때문에 파괴되고 빼앗길 수 있다니...
Queen's Recruit#574.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#575.src: Then you have seen firsthand the benefits. The province is unburdened by those who may cause problems, and Wynn's front in its war is bolstered.
Queen's Recruit#575.dst: 그렇다면 이점도 직접 봤겠군요. 이 지방은 문제를 일으킬 자들의 짐을 덜고, Wynn의 전선은 강화되지요.
Queen's Recruit#575.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#576.src: Of course, many will refuse the call. Many more will grow stagnant in their newfound roles. Yet, in a select few... there is potential for much, much more.
Queen's Recruit#576.dst: 물론 많은 이가 부름을 거부합니다. 더 많은 이는 새 역할에 안주하지요. 하지만 극소수에게는... 훨씬, 훨씬 더 큰 잠재력이 있습니다.
Queen's Recruit#576.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#578.src: That will be all. Return to your chambers for the night. I will be sending for the other finalist shortly.
Queen's Recruit#578.dst: 이상입니다. 오늘 밤은 방으로 돌아가십시오. 곧 다른 결승 진출자를 부르겠습니다.
Queen's Recruit#578.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#579.src: Return to room W-{~} and talk to Tasim at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#581.src: You're back! Still in one piece?
Queen's Recruit#581.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#582.src: ...I was getting a little worried. You were up there a while.
Queen's Recruit#582.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#586.src: Ha. Well, now I'm a little nervous.
Queen's Recruit#586.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#588.src: I'll... need to ask some follow-up questions.
